rationale: The two solutions are the same except for Modifier, and both versions correctly round toward negative infinity. B names the offset (diff) and handles negative values on their own branch with (diff-1)/2, which reads plainly as a floor division adjusted for Go truncating toward zero. A's check, score%2 != 0 && score < 10, is also correct, but it ties the rounding fix to the parity of the raw score rather than of the offset from 10. A reader has to stop and confirm that this works, so it is a little less obvious. Neither version has a comment explaining the floor-division trick. The difference is small, but B states its intent slightly more clearly.
